card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: The middle pieces of newly spelled brand drug names written in capitals, such as SCEMBLIX, PREVYMIS or BYETTA, in dosing and instruction sentences. It fires before the name is finished.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-capitals brand name that is split into parts.

modes.label: Mixed-case brand name
modes.description: The middle of a brand name written in mixed case.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a brand drug name while the name is still being spelled out.
